exposure: Surgery for obesity and weight-related diseases
Women who had only a cesarean birth
International Consultation on Incontinence Questionnaire-Short Form (ICIQ-SF) score
Women who had both vaginal and cesarean deliveries
outcome: Quality of life related to UI
cohort: 221 female patients over 18 years old who underwent surgery for obesity and weight-related diseases
finding: Surgery for obesity and weight-related diseases may lead to improvement in UI, with previous cesarean section being associated with the highest rate of remission of symptoms.
mod_finding: Women who had only a cesarean birth had a 117% increase in the probability of achieving remission of UI compared with women who had both vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
